title: Kehti Hai Roro Kar Yeh Maa Aaye Mera Asghar Be Zubaan
body:
Kehti hai roro kar yeh maa aaye mera Asghar be zubaan
Dhoond ne mai jao kaha aaye mera Asghar be zubaan
1. Loori sunao mai kise jhula julao mai kise
Dhood pilao mai kise beta pukaru mai kise
Nazrao se tu kyun hai neha'n....aaye mere Asghar be zubaan
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Qalb tha kya foulad ka reham na khaya hurmala
Teer se us masoom ka pyaasa hi che'da hai gala
Ispe hai Shahid aasmaa'n....aaye mere Asghar be zubaan
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Hasliyoun wale sheer qaar goad ke paale sheer qaar
Raaj dulaare sheer qaar dil ke sahare sheer qaar
Karbal mai raha tu neem jaa'n....aaye mere Asghar be zubaan
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Shaam savere rooti hoon mou aashkoun se dhooti hoon
Ranj mein har dum jeeti hoon har lamha gham sehti hoon
Hai qalb o jigar se khoon rawa'n....aaye mere Asghar be zubaan
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Shasmaha mujahid ran mein lada duniya ne dekha na suna
Par dhaste bala ke jungle mein ek haq ka sipahi aan lada
Maar kiya tune woh maida'n....aaye mere Asghar be zubaan
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Aaye mustafa dekho haal mera mehsar se hi pehle hum
Qurbaniye Asghar se haq ka yeh deen bacha
Islaam seh loongi gire koh e girain....aaye mere Asghar be zubaan
Azz...mustafa qaari
